summary: EQT Private Equity Company LLC filed a Form 8-K on September 22, 2026, reporting that its manager, EQT Partners Inc., determined the Transactional Net Asset Value per share for its outstanding share classes as of August 31, 2026. Class I NAV is $30.55, Class A-I is $30.92, and Class H is $32.13, with total Transactional Net Asset Value of $1,099,323 and 36,235,485 outstanding shares. The prices determine subscription and repurchase levels for this continuously offered private equity vehicle. No special-situation event, deal, or corporate action is involved; this is a routine NAV disclosure.
